question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Followed
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"followed"** means to come after in sequence or time, to go or come after, or to act according to (a law or instruction). (अनुसरण किया)

 
 
• **Example:** She followed the instructions carefully to complete the project.
 
 
 
• **"Obeyed"** refers to complying with a command, order, or law; to follow the directions or instructions of someone. (आज्ञा का पालन किया)
 
 
• **Example:** The soldiers obeyed the general's orders without question.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the word that means the same as 'followed' is 'obeyed'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Transgressed** (उल्लंघन किया): To violate a law, command, or moral code.

 
 
• **Example:** He transgressed the rules by cheating in the exam.
 
 
 
• **Claimed** (दावा किया): To assert or demand recognition of (a right, title, possession, etc.); to state as a fact.
 
 
• **Example:** She claimed that the book was hers.
 
 
 
• **Disobliged** (नाराज किया): To refuse or neglect to do something; to cause inconvenience or discomfort.
 
 
• **Example:** He disobliged his friends by not attending the party.

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
